title: 区域场景与条件分支（关卡救援与分支）（第 3／4 部分）

rows.source: Remember, this meat hoard is our little secret!
rows.current: * 记住，这堆肉可是咱俩的小秘密！

rows.source: Whew! Sure is a lot of work to carve up a dragon.
rows.current: * 呼！把龙切开还真费劲。

rows.source: All you gotta do is... TAEGXLAA... if you know what I mean... He! He! He!

rows.source: Oh hey there, I'm gonna need to see some ID.

rows.source: It's my special recipe! The tastiest, coolest drink on this planet!
rows.current: * 这是我的独家配方！这个星球上最美味、最冰凉的饮料！

rows.source: If cola and tea aren't your speed, then how about some coffee?
rows.current: * 如果可乐和茶都不合你口味，那来点咖啡怎么样？

rows.source: It's from off-world beans, a real pick-me-up!
rows.current: * 用外星咖啡豆做的，提神得很！

rows.source: This stuff will quench your thirst and recover some PSY, but to be honest...

rows.source: ...it won't cool you down like a nice ICECOLA will!
rows.current: * ……可它没法像爽口的 ICECOLA 那样让你凉快下来！

rows.source: It's too hot to talk, sorry!
rows.current: * 太热了，没法说话，抱歉！

rows.source: Can't blame ya. It's too hot down here to do business, right?
rows.current: * 不能怪你。这下面热得要命，根本没法做生意，对吧？

rows.source: That's a shame. Anything else?
rows.current: * 真遗憾。还要点别的吗？

rows.source: Good luck with the heat out there!
rows.current: * 外头热得很，祝你好运！

rows.source: Take care with the heat out there!
rows.current: * 外头这么热，多当心！

rows.source: Wish I could go out and get a nice ICECOLA to beat this heat. Whew!
rows.current: * 真希望能出去弄瓶上好的 ICECOLA 来压压这暑气。呼！

rows.source: Take care with the heat out there!
rows.current: * 外面那么热，你可当心！

rows.source: Wish I could go out and get a nice ICECOLA to beat this heat. Whew!
rows.current: * 真想出去买瓶ICECOLA消消暑。呼！

rows.source: Take care with the heat out there!
rows.current: * 外面那么热，你可当心！

rows.source: Wish I could go out and get a nice ICECOLA to beat this heat. Whew!
rows.current: * 真想出去买瓶ICECOLA消消暑。呼！

rows.source: Oh hey there, It's too hot to do any business right now!
rows.current: * 哦，你好呀，现在太热了，什么生意都做不了！

rows.source: You're free to browse until I get my paws on a nice cool drink...
rows.current: * 在我弄到一杯冰凉的饮料之前，你随便看……

rows.source: Sorry! It's too hot to do any business down here!
rows.current: * 抱歉！这下面热得没法做生意！

rows.source: I can't count money properly until I'm cooled off, ya know?
rows.current: * 不凉快下来，我连钱都数不清，懂吧？

rows.source: Thank you Yiffany!
rows.current: * 谢谢你，伊吠妮！

rows.source: Th-thanks pal! Good luck rescuing the others!
rows.current: * 谢、谢谢你，伙计！祝你救其他人时一切顺利！

rows.source: Please come back soon with your master, and a key!
rows.current: * 请快些带着你的主人和一把钥匙回来！

rows.source: Oh h-hey! Wasn't expecting another agent to get in here!
rows.current: * 哦，嗨、嗨！没想到还有别的特工能进来！

rows.source: I might have myself in a sliight bit of trouble with some wyverns...
rows.current: * 我可能跟几只双足飞龙惹上了那么一丁点儿麻烦……

rows.source: Can you get your master to come back with a key? I'm in a lot of trouble!
rows.current: * 你能让你主人带把钥匙回来吗？我麻烦大了！

rows.source: Thank you, but I'm already rescued!
rows.current: * 谢谢，不过我已经被救出来了！

rows.source: I'm like, fine now. Just some scratches and a bruised ego, that's all!
rows.current: * 我现在嘛，没事了。就是擦破点皮，外加自尊心受了点伤，仅此而已！

rows.source: Y-yay! I'm fine now, just give me a moment to catch my breath.
rows.current: * 太、太好了！我现在没事了，让我缓口气就好。

rows.source: H-how do you agents take this kind of abuse? I'm just a scout!
rows.current: * 你、你们特工是怎么受得了这种折磨的？我只是个侦察兵啊！

rows.source: Get me out of here!!
rows.current: * 快把我弄出去！！

rows.source: I was getting so much topping in before I ended up in here, I swear!
rows.current: * 我发誓，被关进来之前，我可是一直在当攻操人！

rows.source: W-why did they lock me up? I'm just a scout!
rows.current: * 他、他们为什么把我关起来？我只是个侦察兵啊！

rows.source: Get me out of here!!
rows.current: * 快把我弄出去！！

rows.source: Are you gonna help me get off, or just stand there lookin'?
rows.current: * 你是来帮我爽一把，还是就站在那儿看着？

rows.source: I'll... be right behind you. Kinda have to take care of something still...
rows.current: * 我……马上就跟在你后面。还有点事得先处理一下……

rows.source: I'll be right behind you!
rows.current: * 我马上跟在你后面！

rows.source: Hey, where you going?! Don't be scared!!
rows.current: * 嘿，你去哪儿啊？！别害怕啊！！

rows.source: Bye bye. If you wanna help, go find someone strong!
rows.current: * 再见。想帮忙的话，就去找个力气大的来！

rows.source: If you spot any of those hunky dwarves, send 'em my way!
rows.current: * 看到那种壮实的矮人，就叫他们来找我！

rows.source: Toll 'em I know how to give a guy some relief after a long day in the mines...
rows.current: * 跟他们讲，矿工累了一天，我懂怎么解乏……

rows.source: If you spot any of those strong dwarves, send 'em my way!
rows.current: * 要是见到那种力气大的矮人，叫他们来找我！

rows.source: I bet one of them could break me out!
rows.current: * 我敢说他们肯定能把我弄出去！

rows.source: Oh hhh...hello. I've been waiting for someone to come along...
rows.current: * 噢，嗯……你、你好。我一直等着有人来……

rows.source: Someone... to fuck me!
rows.current: * 等个人……来操我！

rows.source: Well then, I guess you're stronger than I thought!
rows.current: * 好吧，看来你的力气比我想的大！

rows.source: Wow!! That was awesome!
rows.current: * 哇！！太厉害了！

rows.source: I'm okay now, just baskin' in the afterglow.
rows.current: * 我现在没事了，正沉浸在余韵里呢。

rows.source: Thanks lad. I'll head back to the hangar in a little while.
rows.current: * 谢谢，小伙子。我过一会儿就回机库。

rows.source: Impressed by how deep I take this toy?
rows.current: * 这玩具我能吞得这么深，佩服吗？

rows.source: Next, why don't we find out how deep I can take... you!
rows.current: * 接下来，试试我能把……你吞多深，怎么样！

rows.source: B-b-but you already have a key! Was it something I said? Sorry!
rows.current: * 可、可、可是你已经有钥匙了！是我说错什么了吗？对不起！

rows.source: I've... already tried picking the lock. I'm afraid you'll have to find a key...
rows.current: * 我……已经试过撬锁了。恐怕你得去找把钥匙……

rows.source: Aww, are you s-sure you don't wanna play...?
rows.current: * 哎呀，你、你确定不想再玩一会儿……？

rows.source: Seeya girl! Watch out for the Barkers!
rows.current: * 回见啦，姑娘！小心那些吠叫者！

rows.source: I guess I'm not getting rescued today? O-okay, well... I'll be waiting.
rows.current: * 看来今天是没人来救我了？好、好吧，那……我会等着。

rows.source: Oh heya! What brings you over here?
rows.current: * 哦，嗨呀！什么风把你吹到这儿来了？

rows.source: You're a real cute doggie and all, but what are you doing here?!
rows.current: * 你是挺可爱的小狗狗没错啦，可你跑这儿来干什么呀？！

rows.source: What's up? Missing something?
rows.current: * 怎么了？是缺什么东西吗？

rows.source: W-wow! Thanks!
rows.current: * 哇、哇哦！谢谢！

rows.source: ...eh, fiiine. I guess this vacation had to end sooner or later.
rows.current: * ……唉，好——吧。我想这假期迟早也得结束。

rows.source: Oh? Are you gonna let me out?!
rows.current: * 哦？你是要放我出去吗？！

rows.source: I... I think I can take it from here. I could even t-take it from *you*! <3
rows.current: * 我……我想接下来自己就能应付了。要是换成*你*来，我、我也吃得消！<3

rows.source: Guess HQ is telling you to get me back to work, huh?
rows.current: * 看样子总部让你催我回去干活了，是吧？

rows.source: Fiiiiine, I'll get my reports in and all that...
rows.current: * 好——啦，我会把报告交上去什么的啦……

rows.source: You know, I've developed a r-real taste for doggies since I landed.
rows.current: * 你知道吗，自从落地后，我就真、真的越来越喜欢狗狗了。

rows.source: I can't help but notice that you're a dog...
rows.current: * 说起来，你不就是狗狗嘛……

rows.source: Gee, this would go real well with a gi, wouldn't it?
rows.current: * 哎呀，这玩意儿配道服正合适，不是吗？

rows.source: Why, who even needs a tazer when you'd be kitted out like that!
rows.current: * 哎呀，你这身装备还用得着电击枪吗！

rows.source: You look like a smart and eager dog!
rows.current: * 你看起来真是只聪明又有干劲的狗！

rows.source: Did you know that ferals are able to dig up dirt by pressing DOWN+ATTACK?
rows.current: * 你知道野兽形态可以按DOWN+ATTACK挖开泥土吗？

rows.source: It's just good info to know, ya know!
rows.current: * 这可是实用的小知识，记着没坏处！

rows.source: It's just one crazy rumor after another out here, I tell ya.
rows.current: * 跟你说，这儿的离谱传闻真是一个接一个。

rows.source: Somebody was telling me that they saw a Werehund in the lower levels, even.
rows.current: * 甚至有人跟我说，在下层看见了一只狼犬。

rows.source: Remember, this is our little secret!
rows.current: * 记住了，这是咱们俩的小秘密！

rows.source: Take some lect, but don't tell anyone, alright?
rows.current: * 拿点 lect 吧，可别跟人说，行吗？

rows.source: Didn't you hear me? There's nothing left!
rows.current: * 你没听见我说话吗？什么都没剩下了！

rows.source: Go be greedy somewhere else!
rows.current: * 想贪，就去别处贪！

rows.source: Hey there! Don't be a stranger, come on in!
rows.current: * 嘿，你好！别见外，快进来吧！

rows.source: You're kinda early! Come back later and we can chat and drink, alright?
rows.current: * 你来得有点早！晚点再来，咱们喝点东西聊聊天，好吗？

rows.source: Well! That last quake just wrecked my whole supply!
rows.current: * 唉！上次地震把我的存货全毁了！

rows.source: I'll tell you what though, you seem like you're a good strong pupper.
rows.current: * 不过说真的，你看着是只挺棒又壮实的狗狗。

rows.source: Another one of you cosmofellas came by muttering that they left
rows.current: * 之前还来过一个跟你一样的太空伙计，嘴里嘀咕着说把武器落在这儿正北边了！

rows.source: their weapon just north of here!
"Bottom, middle, middle, top..." is what they kept saying, whatever that means!
rows.current: * 那家伙一直念叨着"下、中、中、上……"，谁知道是什么意思！

rows.source: I'll be right along! Just as soon I can get away from my buddy here, hehe...
rows.current: * 我马上就跟上来！只要我能从旁边这位伙计那儿脱开身，嘿嘿……

rows.source: Good boy! Come back with your master!
rows.current: * 乖孩子！带你的主人回来！

rows.source: Huh? Are you a good dog? Can you go get someone to help?
rows.current: * 嗯？你是条好狗狗吗？能去找人来帮忙吗？

rows.source: I think I can handle this from here.
rows.current: * 接下来我想自己能搞定了。

rows.source: Ngh... just... need a bit. Th-thanks.
rows.current: * 唔……只是……得歇一会儿。谢、谢谢。

rows.source: Hmm... if I could have just gotten into that panel...
rows.current: * 嗯……要是能打开那个面板就好了……

rows.source: Well, thanks anyway.
rows.current: * 总之，还是谢谢你。

rows.source: Some big kobolds locked me up in here.
rows.current: * 几个大块头狗头人把我关在这里了。

rows.source: And I thought they were my friends...
rows.current: * 我还以为他们是我的朋友呢……

rows.source: It's pretty basic, rook. Put the key in the lock and *turn*.
rows.current: * 挺简单的，菜鸟。把钥匙插进锁里，*转*。

rows.source: Do I have to explain it to you again?
rows.current: * 还得我再给你解释一遍吗？

rows.source: Come back soon! I can't take much more of this boring room!
rows.current: * 快点回来！这无聊的房间我真的快待不下去了！

rows.source: Listen up, rookie! Your immediate assistance is required.
rows.current: * 听好了，新兵！现在需要你立刻来支援。

rows.source: I... a dog?!
rows.current: * 我……一只狗？！

rows.source: Please help me, you guh... aaaah! ... gotta find someone...
rows.current: * 求求你帮帮我，你这……呃啊！……得找个人来……

rows.source: You'll need a key! I've... aaahng! T-tried everything...
rows.current: * 你需要钥匙！我……啊嗯！什、什么都试过了……

rows.source: Aagh! Can't you do anything right?
rows.current: * 啊！你连一件事都做不好吗？

rows.source: Wow, *good job*. Want me to ask command to give you a gold star?
rows.current: * 哇，*真能干*。要不要我请指挥部给你颁颗小金星？

rows.source: I'm fine now. Just need a minute to stretch my legs.
rows.current: * 我现在没事了。只需要点时间活动活动腿脚。

rows.source: Nnngh... hard to believe a machine could make me cum that much...
rows.current: * 嗯呃……真不敢相信，一台机器能让我高潮那么多……

rows.source: Well are you buying or not? Don't waste my time...
rows.current: * 到底买不买？别浪费我时间……

rows.source: I gotta be honest with you, I don't know what animal this is from.
rows.current: * 说实话，我也不知道这是从哪种动物身上弄来的。

rows.source: Makes for good drinkin' if you're *real* thirsty though.
rows.current: * 不过你要是*真的*渴坏了，喝着还挺不错。

rows.source: Be seeing you. Heh-heh...
rows.current: * 回头见。嘿嘿……

rows.source: Take care out there. Ole Tutone's a rough place these days.
rows.current: * 出门小心点。如今这老图托恩可不太平。

rows.source: Well hey there, little lady. I gots some real pree-mo dining here.
rows.current: * 哟，小妞。我这儿可有顶级好菜。

rows.source: Well look what we have here! Come in, come in! Welcome to my junk shop!
rows.current: * 哟，瞧瞧谁来了！进来进来！欢迎光临我的杂货铺！

rows.source: What the-? A dog?!
rows.current: * 什么鬼——？一条狗？！

rows.source: This ain't a peepshow, punk! Show me the lect or get out!
rows.current: * 这儿可不是给你白看的，混蛋！拿出LECT来，不然滚蛋！

rows.source: You stupid or something?! That was my last one!
rows.current: * 你傻了还是咋的？！那是最后一个！

rows.source: You smell pretty cute for a kobold, heh-heh. What crew you fly in with?
rows.current: * 你这科博德，闻起来倒挺讨人喜欢，嘿嘿。你跟哪支船队来的？

rows.source: You smell pretty cute for a kobold, heh-heh. What crew you fly in with?
rows.current: * 作为科博德，你闻着还挺可爱的，嘿嘿。你跟哪伙船员来的？

rows.source: Business been pretty good lately, what with all you spacebrats wandering around.
rows.current: * 最近生意不错，多亏你们这些太空小鬼到处晃悠。

rows.source: This here? One of them tazers those cute lil spacebrats carry around.
rows.current: * 这个？就是那些可爱的太空小混蛋随身带的电击枪。

rows.source: Seemed like a pretty good one, until we broke it... the tazer, I mean.
rows.current: * 没被我们玩坏前还挺好用……我说电击枪。

rows.source: But the scrap alone will go for a thousand lect, off world. How about it?
rows.current: * 可光卖废料，拿到外星都能卖一千LECT。怎么样？

rows.source: Grrr, bring more Lect with you next time, ya scoundrel!
rows.current: * 咕呜，下次多带点 Lect 来，你这混蛋！

rows.source: The scariest part about this outfit...
rows.current: * 这身行头最吓人的地方……

rows.source: ...is that sometimes the zipper gets stuck!
rows.current: * ……就是拉链有时候会卡住！

rows.source: Don't forget to take some food for your pets!
rows.current: * 别忘了给你的宠物带点吃的！

rows.source: Look buddy, if I could see where anything is I'd gladly sell that to you
rows.current: * 听着，老兄，要是我能看清东西在哪儿，我很乐意卖给你，但我每次一动，好像都会踩到什——嗷呜！

rows.source: But every time I move I seem to step on somethi-YEOWCH!
Nope, no sales until the lights are back on. Sorry!
rows.current: * 不行，灯亮之前不卖东西。抱歉！

rows.source: This is just my luck, isn't it?
rows.current: * 我的运气还真是好啊，是吧？

rows.source: First somewan stole my hookshot so I have to walk around on these tiny legs...
rows.current: * 先是有人偷了我的钩索，害我只能靠这两条小短腿走路……

rows.source: ...and now the power is out and my flashlight is missing! Bah!
rows.current: * ……而现在又停电了，手电筒也不见了！哼！

rows.source: It's been getting ruffer and ruffer to do business around these parts, let me tell ya.
rows.current: * 跟你说吧，在这一带做生意是越来越难了。

rows.source: Earthquakes happen every other hour and the monsters are rowdier than ever...
rows.current: * 隔一个小时就地震一次，魔物也比以前更闹腾了……

rows.source: ...it almost feels like things are building up to something!
rows.current: * ……总觉得好像有什么大事要发生了！

rows.source: So anyways, you ever wear an Elven dress before? You look like the sort!
rows.current: * 话说回来，你以前穿过精灵连衣裙吗？你看着就像会穿的！

rows.source: Rumors say they prevent blocks from crumbling beneath your feet
rows.current: * 听说它们靠某种纳米机器，能防止脚下的方块崩塌……

rows.source: thanks to some sort of nano machines...
...but I think it's actually just magic!
rows.current: * ……不过我觉得其实就是魔法！

rows.source: This is a pretty little elven letter opener, if I do say so myself!
rows.current: * 要我自己说，这可是一把精巧的精灵拆信刀！

rows.source: Feather light, just like how those dresses the elves craft will make you feel.
rows.current: * 轻得像羽毛，就跟穿上精灵做的裙子时那种轻盈的感觉一样。

rows.source: ...not that I would know anything about those!
rows.current: * ……当然，那些裙子我一点都不了解！

rows.source: Those Kobo-curs will be mine again!
rows.current: * 那些科博杂种还会再落到我手里的！

rows.source: Those space pirates are gonna regret crossing me...
rows.current: * 那些太空海盗一定会后悔招惹我……

rows.source: Well, about time. I've been waiting for backup!
rows.current: * 总算来了。我等增援都等好久了！

rows.source: Damn, just a dog.
rows.current: * 该死，原来只是条狗。

rows.source: It's a basic forcefield, girl. Your tazer will make short work of it.
rows.current: * 这就是个基本款力场，姑娘。你的电击枪一下就能搞定它。

rows.source: Time for some payback! I'll be queen of the space pirates yet!
rows.current: * 是时候报仇了！我终会成为太空海盗女王！

rows.source: ...metaphorically. I'm not hanging up my cosmosuit or anything.
rows.current: * ……只是个比喻。我还没打算把宇宙服挂起来退役呢。

rows.source: Look, as nice as it is to chit-chat...
rows.current: * 听着，闲聊虽然不错……
